n1.speaker: npc_pell
n1.text: ...C. Thrace. Auditor-General. Room 0 is his office. Every one of them, his.

n2.speaker: npc_pell
n2.text: We cannot take this to Marrow; she signs what Room 0 sends her. Quill knows a door to the Principal's own auditors.

n3.speaker: npc_pell
n3.text: It is a door for a Department Supervisor, not an Adjudicator. Rise, and we will open it together.

effects.title: To Be Continued
effects.text: Act III: rise to Department Supervisor and take the manifest higher.
